summary: Reproduced the independent review counterexamples and corrected the eager DSPARK multinomial boundary. The existing recovery only recognized NaN in column 0. It now replaces any row containing a non-finite or negative value, a non-finite sum, or a non-positive sum with the existing token-0 one-hot fallback while preserving valid rows. The candidate's exact tests passed on the base, but the added four-case regression failed before and passed after this correction.

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-c21e915ae5ae/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/spec/test_dspark_draft_probability_recovery.py (exact candidate test before adding the new regression)
tests.what_was_measured: The candidate's exact three tests passed unchanged on the recorded base: 3 passed.

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-c21e915ae5ae/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/spec/test_dspark_draft_probability_recovery.py (new boundary regression on unmodified production source)
tests.what_was_measured: All four review counterexamples failed recovery before the source correction: NaN outside column 0, positive infinity, a negative value, and a zero-sum row.
After correction: 4 tests passed and 8 device/input subtests passed across CPU and the assigned gfx950.

tests.what_was_measured: On AMD Instinct MI355X, all four malformed rows recovered to token 0, a valid row was preserved, and torch.multinomial completed followed by an explicit device synchronization.
Changed Python files compiled and the patch passed whitespace validation.

gpu_execution.evidence: Focused tests and a synchronized direct boundary probe ran on one AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950) using PyTorch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 and HIP 7.2.26015; raw output is retained under reports/j-c21e915ae5ae/raw/.

remaining_limitations: The assigned environment had one AMD gfx950 GPU under ROCm, not eight NVIDIA H100 GPUs under CUDA.
The rare source of invalid probabilities in the original DeepSeek-V4 CUDA TP=8 workload remains unidentified.
TP=8, full HTTP serving, the fast DSPARK native sampling kernel, week-long production traffic, and model semantics were not reproduced.

The correction is justified as containment of independently reproduced malformed inputs at the implicated eager multinomial boundary; it is not evidence that the upstream producer has been identified.
